_transcription: ENGLISH half only, CBSE Class 10 Science (086), Series GHF2E, SET-2. 27 pages: idx 0 cover, idx 1 Hindi instructions, idx 2 English instructions + Q1; English on EVERY EVEN index 2-26, Hindi on every odd index (each the Hindi of the page after it); odd-page tops checked on the contact sheet, all Hindi (no English overflow); last page idx 26 English (Q39). Question numbers run 1-39 unbroken. Instruction (viii) prints NO count of internal choices, so the roster was built by walking the marking scheme (ms pages 2-11, a per-set scheme: every page footer reads X_086_31/2/2): a bare OR after Q24, 25, 27, 34, 35, 36, 37, 38, 39 = 9 alternatives, each confirmed against a printed OR on the paper. No void note anywhere in the scheme. All 20 Section-A answers are CBSE's own, read off the scheme page images; each was also re-derived and agrees. Decimal points on this paper are RAISED (Q32: 0{\cdot}2). Sibling of 31/2/1: 41 of 54 rows are that paper's questions, reshuffled and renumbered, each confirmed on this paper's page and copied byte-for-byte from 2025-31-2-1 (figure notes re-read and rewritten from this paper's pages); 13 rows are new to this set (Q3, Q6, Q9, Q13, Q14, Q17, Q21, Q23, Q26, Q28, Q29, Q31, Q32).

questions.stem:
